subject.title: [Feature Request] Skill Graph - 按需加载依赖链，减少 Token 消耗

question: Should OpenClaw adopt dependency-driven skill activation in core, or consolidate prompt-token work under the category/search design in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/89361 while leaving graph visualization external?
rationale: This choice changes prompt discovery semantics and introduces skill metadata, CLI, and configuration contracts; source inspection cannot determine the intended permanent product model or acceptable skill-discovery regressions.

options.title: Consolidate lazy discovery
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/89361 as the core design track, require explicit metadata and fallback discovery, and keep visualization in the existing external tool.

options.title: Sponsor dependency graphs
options.body: Define a first-class dependency schema and core runtime traversal contract, with cycle handling, upgrade behavior, and measured selection-quality tests before implementation.

options.title: Keep current mitigations
options.body: Retain prompt budgets, compact formatting, and per-agent allowlists, then close graph-driven core expansion as outside the current roadmap.

recommendation.title: Consolidate lazy discovery
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/89361 as the core design track, require explicit metadata and fallback discovery, and keep visualization in the existing external tool.

likelyOwner.reason: The recent skill prompt and discovery history most consistently routes through this contributor, and the decision spans both prompt behavior and public product surface.
